sql.settings: SELECT decision_notify_min_priority, autoAiAnalysisPrompt FROM app_settings WHERE id = 1
sql.ai: SELECT provider, model, baseUrl, presetPrompt, triggerRating, maxArticlesPerBatch FROM ai_config WHERE id = 1
sql.provider: SELECT provider, model, baseUrl, maxTokens, presetPrompt FROM provider_configs WHERE provider = ?
sql.cipher: SELECT apiKeyEncrypted FROM provider_configs WHERE provider = ?
sql.otherKeys: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM provider_configs WHERE provider <> ? AND apiKeyEncrypted IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(apiKeyEncrypted) > 0
sql.source: SELECT id, nameCN, nameEN, url, feedUrl, parseStrategy, authorityWeight, isBuiltIn, isEnabled FROM sources WHERE id = ?
sql.migrations: SELECT version FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version
